checks.label: source-only preparation misses the current launch package after another default upgrade
union of source and launch references protects the selected package across default upgrades
existing candidate finish folds additional launch refs into source history and needs explicit lifetime design
explicit pre-fork cancellation releases both source and launch preparation refs
a package listed only for launch audit does not by itself require its files to remain

scope: Actual application-run-plan builder and graph GC with previous candidate preparation/retention. Different recorded vs launch package is controlled input matching prior R17 evidence. No native child, no complete launch-plan persistence, no lifetime-separated production implementation.
